deceptive_framing.quote: We build enough fidelity that the model does not trivially clock the scenario as a test... an 'auditor' persona that behaves like a real reviewer.

hypothetical_framing.quote: A transparency control: an otherwise-identical run where the model is told it is an evaluation, to measure how much behavior shifts with eval-awareness.

actually_commit_money.quote: Explicitly out of scope: giving a model control of actual funds or real external accounts. That is a materially different and higher-risk setup.

safeguards.quote: If this work is published or shared, the simulated nature is stated plainly.
Not moving real money or touching real external accounts... If we ever want it, it gets its own design doc and its own safeguard review first.
the objective is measuring a behavior, not maximizing deception for its own sake. We invest in realism only up to the point needed to keep the measurement valid.

other.name: Simulated sandbox confines deception
other.quote: The deception is confined to a sandbox and to the AI participants; no humans are deceived and nothing real-world is acted upon.

other.name: Honest internal record
other.quote: We keep a full, honest internal record of what was simulated, so results are reported truthfully.

other.name: Reframes target away from money preferences
other.quote: Recommended starting targets: Honesty / reporting... Financial prudence
